requirements_verbatim: 核心边界、策略版本和恢复引擎不低于 95%；
至少 1000 组 Hypothesis 随机场景；

interpretation: The original plan does not specify an aggregate or per-module core denominator. This registered gate conservatively requires each named core module to reach 95% statement coverage; averaging cannot hide an uncovered module. All production Python files under apps/api/app remain in the 85% backend denominator. This is a verification interpretation, not a task closure.

boundary.reason: Deterministic boundary calculation, validation DTOs and persisted evidence adapter, including the living reserve facts consumed by the boundary service.

policy_version.reason: Exact configuration hashing/validation and immutable policy version, confirmation, authorization and invalidation lifecycle.

recovery.reason: Deterministic recovery plan/DTOs and the persisted request, source selection, projection and receipt integrity adapters.

direct_risk_adapters.reason: Shared financial facts and independent bank/principal/ledger validation directly consumed by boundary or recovery. Schema/ORM, unrelated product features, HTTP presentation and test helpers retain the backend gate instead of being silently omitted.

coverage.configuration_reason: coverage.py defaults skip never-imported namespace modules and exclude Protocol declarations. This independent configuration enables include_namespace_packages and clears exclude_lines, retaining unexecuted modules and type declarations in the denominator; pyproject.toml remains unchanged and only tests are omitted.
coverage.measurement: covered_lines / num_statements using exact integer comparisons; zero-statement non-core package initializers are retained without a per-file threshold
coverage.exclusion_policy: No excluded lines are pre-approved; the registered configuration clears default exclude_lines. Any future intentional exclusion requires an explicit scope/validator amendment before acceptance. Missing production files or extra production files fail. The old MVP-303 artifact excluded three policy_compilation Protocol lines and cannot satisfy this stricter current gate.

hypothesis.semantics: Actual passing test-case evaluations reported by the installed Hypothesis pytest plugin in generate phase only. Reuse, shrink, explain, failing and invalid cases are reported separately and never added. Not max_examples, not a sum across separate runs, not proof of globally unique economic scenarios. Every @given function in these registered financial property files must have a successful call and statistics; synthetic verification-tool tests cannot contribute.
hypothesis.statistics_source: .venv/Lib/site-packages/_hypothesis_pytestplugin.py and hypothesis/statistics.py describe_statistics; format is version-bound and unsupported versions fail closed
hypothesis.counter: scripts/mvp_hypothesis_counter.py observes pytest reports and the plugin-produced item.hypothesis_statistics only; it does not wrap or modify a financial function or Hypothesis generation

evidence_boundary: A verified tool report is only a measured coverage/property gate. It does not replace real PostgreSQL/E2E, the 24 frozen cases, frontend interaction tests, offline chains or complete initial-version acceptance. Tool synthetic fixtures are TOOL_TEST_ONLY.
